about: The app set to Deutsch (PATCH /api/config language "de", as ui launch sets English), then New bot. The dialog picks a random shape and colour, so the capture clicks the first shape and the orange swatch on both.

steps.eval: fetch('/api/config', { method: 'PATCH', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ language: 'de' }) }).then((r) => r.status)
(document.querySelector('[data-tour] button, button'), [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => /Neuer Bot|New bot/.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? b.title ?? ''))?.click(), true)
